# #1792: Patch: the browser tab says it is your move during the mulligan and when a prompt waits on you, not only on your turn
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
In an online match the browser tab's title reads "Your turn", so a player who switched tabs can find the game. Today it follows only whose turn it is:
- During the opening mulligan, the player going first sees "Your turn" the whole time, even after pressing Ready.
- The player going second, who still has to choose, sees nothing.
- A choice the game asks of you during your opponent's turn doesn't flag the tab either.

Once built, the tab is flagged exactly when the game is waiting on you.

## Why
- `apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx:325-328`: `yourTurn = view !== null && view.result === null && view.active === view.viewer`.
- A new game's `active` is P1 (`crates/engine/src/state.rs:2119`) and stays P1 until the first turn starts (`turn.rs:383`), so P1 always reads as active during the mulligan.
- The view already carries the mulligan as `PlayerView.mulligan` (`youReady`, `opponentReady`; `wire/generated/MulliganView.ts`, R265, R266). The title never reads it.
- A prompt waiting on the viewer is `pending.forYou`. `promptHolderOf` (`match.tsx:66-70`) already works out who a prompt waits on, but the title doesn't use it.
- The co-op table has the same rule (`apps/web/src/duos/DuosRoute.tsx:153-161`, `view.own.active === view.own.viewer`).
- The only title test (`routes/match.test.tsx:558-568`) covers just the active-player case.

## Proposal
Add one small pure helper, `awaitsYou(view)`. It is true only when there is no result and:
- the mulligan is open and the viewer has not answered it (`!mulligan.youReady`); otherwise
- a prompt is open and it is the viewer's (`pending.forYou`); otherwise
- it is the viewer's turn (`active === viewer`).

Use it for the 1v1 title, and on `view.own` for the co-op title, keeping co-op's `round > 0` and ended-duel checks. It reads only the view (CLAUDE.md rule 7).

## Where it lands
- `apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx`, `apps/web/src/duos/DuosRoute.tsx`
- `apps/web/src/routes/match.test.tsx` and the co-op route's test
- §2.1 (the mulligan). No spec change.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Mulligan open, viewer p2 not yet ready: the title is "Your turn · JackiOh".
- [ ] Mulligan open, viewer p1 already ready: the title is the match's plain title, even though `active` is p1.
- [ ] On the opponent's turn, a prompt with `forYou: true` flags the title.
- [ ] On the viewer's turn, a prompt waiting on the opponent does not flag it.
- [ ] The existing active-player test still passes, and the co-op route gets the same mulligan and prompt cases.
- [ ] The web test files touched, typecheck and eslint pass.

## Size and risks
Extra small: one helper, two call sites and a handful of tests. No risk to play: it changes only `document.title`.
